findings.summary: PLANS.md task 11.1 and 11.2 status blocks retain the superseded 'provider failure keeps the bounded last-known-good ... without extending the window' claim (lines ~4191 and ~4259-4260) without a superseded annotation, while the sibling task 11.1 changelog sentence was annotated.
findings.detail: The current-state surfaces (Project Status paragraph, milestone row 11, task 11.4 block, changelog Phase 11 header, docs/project-status.md, docs/limitations.md F1) are correctly reconciled, and the surrounding text is a point-in-time task record. However, the provider-failure sentence is a behavioral claim that is false for the shipped readers (they cache nothing on a library-read failure), and PLANS.md does not annotate it as superseded the way docs/changelog.md's task 11.1 entry does.
findings.recommended_action: Add a one-line '(superseded by task 11.4)' pointer to the task 11.1/11.2 status blocks, or record the deliberate decision to leave all task-scoped historical blocks unannotated and rely on the task 11.4 block.

findings.summary: docs/changelog.md task 11.2 completed-work entry (lines 3129-3130) retains the same false 'a provider failure keeps the bounded last-known-good observation set until the TTL without extending the window' claim without a superseded annotation, unlike the task 11.1 entry immediately above it.
findings.detail: Historically the task 11.2 reader never wired WithFailure and never stores lastError, so the sentence was inaccurate at the time it was written. The task 11.1 changelog sentence was annotated as superseded by task 11.4; the task 11.2 sentence was not, producing an inconsistent treatment of the same class of claim on the changelog completed-work surface.
findings.recommended_action: Annotate the task 11.2 changelog sentence as superseded by task 11.4 (mirroring the task 11.1 annotation), or state explicitly in the task 11.4 entry that only the task 11.1 sentence is annotated.

findings.summary: ADR-018 Decision clause 5 still reads 'on provider failure the existing bounded last-known-good semantics apply' in the paragraph about the inventory cache, a divergence from the shipped behavior (a library-read failure caches nothing; the per-item metadata state retains last-known-good). The added Consequences clauses record the correct behavior, but the Decision text itself is unannotated.
findings.detail: The instruction is to record a divergence between an ADR and behavior, not silently rewrite ADR decision text. The worker edited only the Consequences (adding the Sonarr O(series), sparse-window amplification, and failure-blast-radius clauses), which does record the divergence. Decision clause 5 remains literally divergent and could still be read as inventory failure retention.
findings.recommended_action: Optionally add a one-line pointer in Decision clause 5 or a Divergence note tying it to the Consequences/library-read-failure behavior; treat as a recorded divergence, not a rewrite.

findings.summary: docs/data-model.md 3.9 is headed 'MetadataCacheEntry' and ADR-018 clause 6 / the ArrInventoryCacheEntry XML doc reference that name, while the implementing code type is MetadataStateEntry.
findings.detail: Pre-existing heading-vs-type naming mismatch, already recorded INFORMATIONAL by the task 11.1 reviewers; task 11.4 introduces no new reference to the inconsistent name and the new section 6 text follows the authoritative docs/ADR wording.
findings.recommended_action: No action for task 11.4; consider a later documentation pass (e.g. Phase 13) to align the data-model heading with the code type name.

summary: Task 11.4 correctly reconciles the canonical current-state documentation for the v1.1 provider inventory cache (Goal C, ADR-018). F1 is consistently recorded as resolved at the integration-test level across docs/limitations.md, docs/project-status.md, PLANS.md (Project Status, milestone row 11, task 11.4, acceptance checkboxes), docs/changelog.md (Phase 11 header), docs/architecture.md (status line, sections 8 and 12), docs/data-model.md section 6, docs/implementation-readiness.md, and README.md; the remaining bounds are stated honestly and ADR-018 Consequences records them. Gate 11 is correctly NOT claimed met (the phase review and tag v1.1.0-phase11 are called out as outstanding). The ArrInventoryCache* XML docs match the shipped behavior (WithFailure/TryStore lastError unwired, Stale is the TTL second-half state, cold library-read failure caches nothing, sub-read fallback), verified against the readers and cache source. Independent './build.sh build' (0 warnings/0 errors), the full suite (Failed 0, Passed 1421, Skipped 63, Total 1484), and the focused Goal C suite (55 passed) reproduce the worker's validation. No production behavior changed (XML-doc-only src diff). Three LOW findings remain: the PLANS.md task 11.1/11.2 status blocks and the docs/changelog.md task 11.2 entry retain the false 'provider failure keeps bounded last-known-good inventory' wording without the superseded annotation applied to the task 11.1 changelog sentence (D-11.4-1, D-11.4-2), and ADR-018 Decision clause 5 still reads as failure-driven inventory retention although the Consequences now record the divergence (D-11.4-3, status recorded). None of these is a current-state overclaim: every surface presented as current is accurate and no unverified capability is presented as available. Verdict: PASS_WITH_FINDINGS.
